# GEO report: Millstone Bakery **New to GEO?** GEO (generative engine optimization) means making your site easy for search engines and AI tools to find, read and quote. This report checks the technical basics. ## Code score: 100/100, Strong Confidence: High (checked 23 of 23 points). How it's calculated: low = 23 ÷ 23 × 100 = 100. High = (23 + 0) ÷ 23 × 100 = 100. This is a small static HTML site with 4 pages, and I read all of them. Every applicable rule is clear in the code. Real server behaviour is the main thing the code can't show (see "Can't tell from code"). All results are "read from code", not measured on a live site. ## Live check - **Not run.** To add it, give me your site's URL. ## Do these first Nothing is broken. The biggest unknown is bot protection, which code can't show, so that is item 1. Items 2 and 3 come from the content ideas below. ### 1. Confirm real crawlers get through your host or CDN - **Why it matters:** a firewall can block search crawlers even when `robots.txt` allows them. - **Where:** outside the repository (hosting or CDN settings) - **What the code says:** `User-agent: *` / `Allow: /` (`robots.txt:1-2`) - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 100 either way. This confirms the result and doesn't move it. ### 2. List the actual breads on `/breads.html` - **Why it matters:** the page says there are many loaves but names only two, so there's little for a reader or an AI tool to quote. - **Where:** `breads.html:15` - **What the code says:** `

Over twenty loaves through the week, including our seeded rye and the country white.

` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 100 ### 3. Add class details to `/classes.html` - **Why it matters:** the page gives no dates, price, class size or address. - **Where:** `classes.html:15` - **What the code says:** `

Learn to bake sourdough in a small group. Book early, because places go quickly.

` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 100 ## All results | Rule | What it checks | Code | Where | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | GEO-013 | robots.txt is valid | Clear | `robots.txt` valid lines, tiny | | GEO-009 | Search crawlers allowed | Clear | `robots.txt:1-3`; only `/members/` and GPTBot are blocked | | GEO-014 | Routes are indexable | Clear | 3 of 3 sitemap routes indexable; `members/index.html:9` is a deliberate noindex | | GEO-015 | Absolute canonical on own origin | Clear | `index.html:8`, `breads.html:8`, `classes.html:8` | | GEO-003 | Content in server HTML | Clear | Static HTML, 4 of 4 pages | | GEO-004 | JSON-LD valid | Not applicable | No JSON-LD found | | GEO-011 | Sitemap discoverable | Clear | `sitemap.xml`; `robots.txt:8` | | GEO-012 | Title, description, lang | Clear | All 4 pages have all three | | GEO-016 | Server-rendered links | Clear | `
` on every page, plain `` | | GEO-017 | No snippet conflict | Clear | No page-wide `nosnippet`; `breads.html:16` uses element-level `data-nosnippet` | | GEO-002 | Accessibility basics | Clear | Read all 4 pages; `index.html:16` image has alt | | GEO-101 | App association files | Not applicable | Not an app | | GEO-010 | llms.txt (info only) | Not applicable | None present, not scored | | GEO-102 | App structured data (info only) | Not applicable | Not an app | ## Other problems found - **Image file missing from the repo:** `index.html:16`: ``. No `img/` folder is in the repository, so this may 404. If the images are deployed from elsewhere, ignore this. Otherwise add the file. ## Worth considering - **Name the breads:** `breads.html:15`: `Over twenty loaves through the week`. Give each loaf a heading and a short description. A page per loaf could work later. - **Back up "wide range":** `index.html:15`: `We bake a wide range of loaves from heritage grains`. Name the grains or loaves, or link to the list. - **Say how to order:** `index.html:15`: `Pre-order for weekend collection.` Nothing says how to pre-order. Add the method, the cut-off and the collection times. - **Add address and opening hours:** the site never states them in text. Put them on the home page or a `/visit` page. You could also label them with `Bakery` structured data, which might help machines read them. - **Add class dates and prices:** `classes.html:15`: `Book early, because places go quickly.` Add dates, price, group size, duration and a booking link. - **Link the home page to Classes:** the only link in `index.html:17` goes to Breads. Add a link to `/classes.html` in the body text. - **Add site identity:** no Organization or WebSite structured data exists. Use the name and address the site already shows. - **Add `` dates:** `sitemap.xml:3-5` has none. Add real last-modified dates if you have them. - **Add social tags:** none of the pages set `og:title`, `og:description` or `og:image`. - **Make the home title more specific:** `index.html:6`: `Millstone Bakery, sourdough in York`. This is fine. You could add the street or area. ## Can't tell from code - **GEO-013 and GEO-014 (live only):** whether `/robots.txt` and the sitemap URLs really answer 200, and whether any `X-Robots-Tag` header is set by the host. A live scan would confirm this. - **Bot protection:** code can't show whether a CDN or firewall lets real crawlers through. Run `geopilot logs ` to check real crawlers against their published addresses. ## Assumptions - You want AI search tools to find this site. `geo.config.json` sets `aiSearchCrawlers: allow`. - The `/members/` page is meant to stay private. It is both noindexed and disallowed in `robots.txt`, and I treated that as deliberate. So is blocking GPTBot (`robots.txt:5-6`), which matches `trainingCrawlers: block`. ## What to do next 1. Run the geopilot `fix` command to apply item 1. You'll see every change before anything is written. 2. Run the geopilot `explain` command with any rule id, such as `GEO-014`, to learn more. 3. For proof from a running site, ask for a live scan with its URL. Technical readiness only. GEO does not measure or predict citations, rankings, traffic or inclusion in any AI or search product.
